summary: A stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Quill's HTML editor allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript by inserting a crafted onloadstart attribute on an IMG element. The behavior is disputed as potentially intentional browser behavior rather than a product vulnerability.
Quill 2.0.3 is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via insufficient data validation in the HTML export feature, allowing injected HTML content to execute in the browser.
